The first four are the fast slate; the last three run only if the machine reaches them before the deterministic evasion pass finishes, and any lane not reached is reported as not-dispatched rather than as an outcome. Width is two concurrent lanes while the one-minute load average is under 8, runs stay back-to-back within a lane, the timeout is 1800 seconds, and one-minute load samples are recorded for every run. The helper-family axis belongs to the earlier duplicate-implementation task and does not apply here; it is held constant at 'both' across every lane and no result is reported by it.
